title: Showtime — The Story Is Ours
summary: A campaign for interactive cinema, where the audience votes on what happens next — from bus shelters to the Instagram grid.
overview: Showtime is a concept for interactive cinema: one screen, one room, and an audience that chooses the story together from their phones. "The Story Is Ours" introduces the idea across out-of-home and social, using a film-noir world and a single graphic device — a red dot that becomes the choice point in every frame.

cover.alt: Five Showtime posters lit up in a city bus shelter at dusk on a wet street, with lines like Same screen. A different story. and You're in.

challenge.heading: The challenge
body: Interactive cinema is a new behaviour. People need to understand at a glance that this isn't streaming at home and isn't a normal movie night — it's a story the whole room decides.

idea.heading: The idea
body: Make the choice the hero. The O in SHOWTIME is a red dot that branches into paths — A, B or C — so the logo itself explains the product. Lines like "Same screen. A different story.", "Every choice a new story." and "You're in." do the rest.

A noir palette of black, cream and cinema red keeps every touchpoint recognisable, from a five-panel bus shelter sequence ending in a QR code ("Scan. Choose. Watch together.") to a six-post Instagram launch.

execution.heading: Deliverables
body: Brand mark and tagline, a five-poster out-of-home series, a six-post social launch with captions and hashtags, and concession packaging applications.

gallery.alt: Six phones showing the Showtime Instagram launch: the logo under a spotlight, a red-haired woman, a branching A-B-C film strip, a phone vote reading Trust him or Walk away, popcorn packaging, and posters on a brick wall
